verdict.rationale: Kong's Dev Portal explicitly lets developers browse/search API documentation, try operations, and manage credentials, with public/no-auth visibility options and APIs published via OpenAPI/AsyncAPI plus Markdown docs; the Catalog feature further provides a platform-level inventory across APIs, API packages, AI Models, MCP servers, and agents for org-wide discovery. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the portal in production use and more detail on team-based access/consumption workflows beyond docs claims.
